description:
Leave a comment on one passage of a note. It appears in the reader's Obsidian sidebar, badged as coming from an agent.

`quote` is the anchor and must appear in the note verbatim — the same characters, punctuation, capitalization and spacing. Copy it from obelisk_list; do not retype it or tidy it up. There is no way to pass a line or column, and you should not try to count them: the quote is the anchor and the tool does the arithmetic. If the quote is not found, or is found more than once, nothing is written and you are told which.

`body` is markdown. To propose a specific rewrite, put it in a ```suggestion fenced block inside the body — its contents replace exactly the quoted passage when the reader clicks Apply, so a comment can explain itself and propose the change at once.

body.description: The comment, as markdown. A ```suggestion block inside it proposes a replacement for the quoted passage.

model.description: Recorded on the comment as the model that wrote it.

nearLine.description: Only when the quote appears more than once: the body line number, as printed by obelisk_list, of the occurrence you mean.

note.description: Path to the note, relative to the vault root or to the working directory. Absolute paths reach a note in another vault. `.md` optional.

quote.description: The passage to anchor to, copied verbatim out of the note.

run.description: Groups the comments from one review pass so the reader can dismiss them together. Defaults to this session's id; pass the same value for every comment in a pass.

name: obelisk_comment
title: Comment on a passage
